cards.title: Service-first approach
cards.body: We put your needs first with a focus on honest advice, quality installation, and long-term support. Installation quality matters—because your security and peace of mind come first.

cards.title: Clear communication
cards.body: We believe in keeping things simple and straightforward. No confusing tech jargon—just clear explanations, transparent updates, and friendly support every step of the way.

cards.title: Right-sized solutions
cards.body: We design solutions that fit your property, your needs, and your budget. No unnecessary extras—just the right technology to keep you secure and in control.

cards.title: Gradual, responsible growth
cards.body: We build lasting relationships based on trust. Start with what you need today, and scale your system at a pace that's right for you. We're here for the long run.

notes: Icon circle color appears as a purple gradient (light purple top-left to darker purple bottom-right) — use linear-gradient(135deg, #9B4FF0, #6A1FD0) if gradient icons are desired, otherwise flat #7B2FE0 works as a close match.
Each card title has a short underline/accent bar beneath it in solid purple, roughly 40px wide, positioned directly under the title text.

Icons in the source image appear to be simple line/outline style icons (rounded stroke, white on purple), consistent with the lucide-react icon set — swap library if a different icon set is preferred, just keep matching glyphs (heart-in-hand, chat bubble, puzzle piece, bar-chart-with-arrow).
Vertical divider lines between columns are subtle and light gray, roughly 80% of card height, centered vertically relative to the card content.
On mobile, stack cards vertically as a single column and drop the divider lines.
